sources.gnomad_variant: POST https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api with GnomADClient._VARIANT_QUERY, variables {variantId, datasetId: gnomad_r4}
sources.alphamissense_csv: GET the amAnnotationsUrl advertised by the prediction record

meta.sanitisation: Verbatim subsets of live responses. Ensembl VEP hits keep every variant-level field and the transcript consequences flagged canonical; colocated_variants and non-canonical transcript consequences are removed. gnomAD bodies are verbatim except that HGDP/1KG subset population rows (ids containing ':') are removed from the two common variants that have an exome cohort; the genome-only variant 17-43105117-T-C is complete. AlphaFold DB prediction arrays keep the first two model records reduced to identity fields and amAnnotationsUrl; AlphaMissense CSVs keep the header and the substitution rows the tests look up. 'dropped' counts what was removed per response and 'live_body_sha256' is the SHA-256 of each complete live body.
